product.title: Seoul Urban Nature Bike Tour along Han River

description.text: In Seoul, this three-hour guided ride meets outside Jayang Station Exit 2 at Ttukseom Recreation Area, then follows the Han River path through Seoul Forest and Seongsu-dong. Bicycle rental, a rain coat if needed, snacks, and a local guide are listed. Reviews on the public page mention an optional chicken picnic at the end. The format suits visitors who want a guided riverside ride without renting independently. Meeting points are confirmed at booking in Seoul, and the itinerary stays on the Han River, Seoul Forest, and Seongsu-dong that define this outing rather than a palace coach day.
